pages.title: Cute FNAF Plush Birthday Party Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute plush versions of Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, Golden Freddy, and Foxy sit together at a birthday celebration in this detailed printable coloring page. The animatronic toys hold a microphone, guitar, bottle, and cupcake around a frosted birthday cake topped with a candle shaped like the number nine, while confetti and streamers cover the floor. Add rich details with colored pencils.
